description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Integrated SDL3 input/rendering to support launching Minecraft 26.3+; gamepad input now aligns with a mode-selection prompt on first input, plus a new master switch for gamepad control.
2. New plugin manager: renderer/driver/native plugins are managed in one place, with RendererPlugin V2 and per-plugin environment variable support; MioLibPatcher can now be enabled/disabled with feature toggles.
3. Skin 3D preview rebuilt: GLTF model + baked animations + voxelized overlay layer.
4. Integrated JSound (javax.sound → OpenAL bridge) to improve in-game audio compatibility.
5. Control converter rewritten in Kotlin with support for importing ZL2 layouts.
6. Idle animation now randomly plays variants; in-game left/right menu items are now card-styled.
7. Download page category tabs now show icons with a refreshed download manager panel; the version list category indicator is now a TabLayout.
8. Selection dialogs unified into a card-based style; renderer selection now shows its source (built-in/plugin).
9. FCLSpinner rewritten: fixed sliding indicator glitches and fake callbacks, text now tints with the theme, with new transition animations.
10. Unified game log sharing: crash logs (hs_err) are attached and access tokens are sanitized.
11. Faster Fabric download list loading; control data serialization switched to hand-written JSON, eliminating Gson recursive-parsing stalls.
12. Turnip driver loading rewritten with a namespace scheme, fixing SDL proxy resolution and EGL library path issues.
13. Fixed multiplayer node list unresponsive clicks, OOM when exporting large MCBBS modpacks, a skin preview shutdown crash, the crash page background not following dark mode, and false update prompts.
14. Added Japanese, Turkish and Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) language options.
15. Updated translations.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.集成 SDL3 输入/渲染以支持启动 Minecraft 26.3+；手柄输入对齐，首次手柄输入弹窗选择模式，新增手柄控制总开关
2.新增插件管理功能：统一管理渲染器/驱动/native 插件，支持 RendererPlugin V2 与环境变量配置；MioLibPatcher 支持启用/禁用与功能开关
3.皮肤 3D 预览重构：GLTF 模型 + 烘焙动画 + 体素化第二层
4.集成 JSound（javax.sound → OpenAL 桥接），提升游戏音频兼容性
5.控件转换器重写为 Kotlin 并支持导入 ZL2 布局
6.待机动画随机插播变体；游戏内左右菜单条目卡片化
7.下载页分类 tab 添加图标并优化下载管理面板样式；版本列表分类指示器改为 TabLayout
8.选择类弹窗统一为卡片式风格，渲染器选择新增来源显示（内置/插件）
9.FCLSpinner 重写：修复滑动指示器错乱与伪回调，文字随主题着色并新增过渡动画
10.统一游戏日志分享逻辑，附带 hs_err 崩溃日志并脱敏 accessToken
11.优化 Fabric 下载列表加载速度；控制数据序列化改手写 JSON，消除 Gson 递归解析卡顿
12.Turnip 驱动加载重写为命名空间方案，修复 SDL 代理解析与 EGL 库路径问题
13.修复联机节点列表点击无响应、导出 MCBBS 整合包内存溢出、皮肤预览退出崩溃、崩溃页背景不随亮暗切换、检查更新首次误报等问题
14.语言切换新增日语、土耳其语、繁体中文（台湾）选项
15.更新多语言翻译
